2. Description of the App

BikePilot is a cycling-computer app that uses your device's GPS, barometer, and optional Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) sensors (heart rate, speed & cadence, temperature) to display and record ride data such as speed, distance, altitude, grade, and route on a map. Some features are only available with an optional auto-renewable subscription ("BikePilot PRO"), as described below.

3. Not a Safety or Medical Device

BikePilot is provided for informational and recreational purposes only. It is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or health condition, nor to replace professional medical, navigational, or safety judgment. GPS, barometric, and Bluetooth sensor readings (including heart rate) may be inaccurate, delayed, or unavailable due to hardware limitations, environmental conditions, weather, or connectivity issues.

You are solely responsible for your own safety while cycling. Always keep your primary focus on the road, traffic, and your surroundings. Do not rely on the App as your sole source of navigation or physiological monitoring, and consult a qualified physician before undertaking strenuous physical activity, especially if you have any pre-existing health condition.

4. Your Content and Data

Ride recordings, GPS tracks, and sensor data you create using the App are stored locally on your device, as described in our Privacy Policy. You are responsible for maintaining your own backups (for example, by exporting rides as .gpx files) — the Developer is not responsible for any loss of ride data resulting from device loss, damage, App deletion, or operating-system changes.

If you import .gpx files into the App, you represent that you have the right to use that data and that doing so does not infringe any third party's rights.
